data.description: High-Floor Luxury Apartments in Elite Residence, Dubai Marina
data.long_description:
Presenting this spacious high-floor apartment in Elite Residence, Dubai Marina, offering stunning sea views and a well-planned layout ideal for comfortable family living.

The property features a bright and airy living area with large windows that fill the space with natural light and provide beautiful open sea views. The apartment includes a closed kitchen, offering privacy and functionality, along with a generously sized balcony — perfect for relaxing and enjoying the surroundings.

This unit also comes with a maid’s room and a separate storage room, adding extra convenience and space for everyday living. The bedrooms are well-proportioned, and the overall layout is designed to maximize both comfort and practicality.

Elite Residence is a premium tower known for its excellent facilities, including indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, sauna, steam room, children’s play area, and 24/7 security.

Ideally located in the heart of Dubai Marina, the building is within walking distance to Marina Walk, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, and public transport, including tram and metro access.

This is an excellent opportunity to rent a high-floor apartment with sea views in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.
